title: Print a greeting
summary: Haskell: Print a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: main is the starting action. putStrLn writes a line of text.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
main is the output action. putStrLn writes the string without its quote marks.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Text uses double quotes; single quotes hold one character.
